args.code:
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the attached file
data = files[0]["table"]
x = data["x"]
y = data["y"]
shift = data["raman_shift_cm-1"]
intensity = data["intensity"]

# Get unique positions
unique_pos = np.unique(np.stack([x, y], axis=1), axis=0)
n_points = len(unique_pos)
print(f"Found {n_points} unique points in the map.")

intensities_at_1000 = []
coords = []

for ux, uy in unique_pos:
    # Mask for this position
    mask = (x == ux) & (y == uy)
    p_shift = shift[mask]
    p_intensity = intensity[mask]
    
    # Find index nearest to 1000 cm-1
    idx = np.argmin(np.abs(p_shift - 1000))
    intensities_at_1000.append(p_intensity[idx])
    coords.append([ux, uy])

coords = np.array(coords)
vals = np.array(intensities_at_1000)

# Plot heatmap
plt.figure(figsize=(6, 5))
sc = plt.scatter(coords[:, 0], coords[:, 1], c=vals, s=500, marker='s', cmap='viridis')
plt.colorbar(sc, label='Intensity at ~1000 cm-1')
plt.xlabel('X (mm)')
plt.ylabel('Y (mm)')
plt.title('Spatial Heatmap of Intensity at 1000 cm-1')
plt.grid(True)

# Print values for verification
for i in range(n_points):
    print(f"Pos ({coords[i,0]}, {coords[i,1]}): Int={vals[i]:.2f}")
